text:
Sam: Quick note from on-call: node-12 showed sustained PCIe saturation when multiple tenants hit massive KV refaults. we need smarter offload pacing that reacts to PCIe telemetry, not just memory pressure.
Lina: Agree. Current trigger is residency_percent which is blind to PCIe backlog. propose a PCIe-aware pacing token that reduces offload rate when dma_latency_ms or pcie_util high.
Victor: How about an adaptive token-bucket whose refill_rate = base_rate * (1 - util_normalized) where util_normalized = clamp((pcie_util - target)/ (100-target), 0,1). gives graceful throttle as util approaches 100%.
Harpreet: Nice. Also include dma_latency trend to detect queueing even when util not peaked (e.g., NVLink smoothing). maybe use max(normalized_util, normalized_dma_latency).
Sam: We also need tenant prioritization. tokens are partitioned: reserved for premium, shared pool for standard. premium gets emergency tokens that can temporarily ignore pacing but consume a debt counter.
Lina: Debt sounds risky. Instead track "burst_credit" per tenant with decay. emergency draws from burst_credit; when negative, reduce future burst allowance. simpler than debt accounting.
Victor: Implementation sketch:
```
offload_pacing:
  base_rate_mb_s: 40
  pcie_target_pct: 70
  token_bucket_size_mb: 64
  per_tenant_shares: {premium: 0.6, standard: 0.4}
  burst_credit_mb: {premium: 256, standard: 64}
  dma_latency_smoothing_ms: 200
```
Sam: telemetry we need: offload_tokens_used, offload_tokens_limited_count, pcie_util_pct, dma_latency_ms_p50_p95, tenant_burst_credit. Throw alerts when tokens_limited_count spikes.
Harpreet: Safety: soft-mode initially: don't cancel inflight DMAs, only throttle new ones. hard-mode adds cancel when dma_latency > 200ms and pcie_util > 95%. feature-flag both.
Lina: Edge-case: when estimator undercounts recompute cost, throttling increases user-perceived latency. mitigation: conservative recompute_estimator and sample-traffic to validate. fallback is LRU if telemetry offline.
telemetry-bot: canary-plan: rollout pacing soft-mode to 2 staging nodes at 02:00 UTC. auto-rollback if p99 tail > 2x baseline for 5m.
Sam: Dev tasks: (1) token-bucket in offload-controller, (2) PCIe/dma collector hook, (3) per-tenant burst accounting / UI, (4) dashboards + alerts. Lina will draft RFC with algorithm + configs.
Victor: Nice. Also add chaos test that injects artificial PCIe lag to validate adaptive behavior.
Lina: will add to RFC. Sam: please add owners and timeline in the doc. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
